'''Creshaldyne Industries''' was a manufacturing corporation specializing in [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> used by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and paramilitary organizations. Their products included the [[MK.IV riot armor]] and its modified variant called [[Cresh Luck armor/Legends|Cresh Luck armor]], and [[camo scout armor]].<ref name="GG10" />

Well-respected armor designer [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nashiak Llalik]] occasionally collaborated with this company on different designs.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
